title: Customer Testimonial Spotlight
description: A focused executive testimonial spotlight highlighting quote, corporate logo, and verified impact metrics.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Customer Testimonial Spotlight Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
